title: Physics is the Best Teacher: Consistency Learning for Time-Invariant Operators of Chaotic Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2610.04108v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Accelerating the prediction of long-term behavior in chaotic systems is crucial in scientific computing. However, existing methods rely on numerical solvers or autoregressive models that advance one small step at a time, which makes long horizons expensive. We instead view this problem as learning the system's time-invariant evolution operator, which jumps the state across a large time span in a single evaluation. To this end, we derive the consistency equations a time-invariant operator must satisfy, with differential and compositional objectives in physical time. These equations also connect the learned operator to the physics-prescribed instant dynamics, enabling physics embedding in consistency learning. Across five chaotic systems, we find that physics-distilled consistency makes both short-term trajectories and long-term statistics more accurate. The learned operator survives temporal extrapolation and requires one-tenth as man

translated_title: 物理是最好的老师：面向混沌动力学时不变算子的一致性学习
translated_abstract: 加速预测混沌系统的长期行为在科学计算中至关重要。然而，现有方法依赖于数值求解器或自回归模型，每次只能推进一小步，这使得长时间跨度的预测代价高昂。我们转而将该问题视为学习系统的时间不变演化算子，该算子能够在单次评估中将状态跳越一个大的时间跨度。为此，我们推导出时不变算子必须满足的一致性方程，包含物理时间下的微分与复合目标。这些方程还将学习到的算子与物理规定的瞬时动力学联系起来，从而实现物理知识在一致性学习中的嵌入。在五个混沌系统上的实验表明，经物理蒸馏的一致性学习使短期轨迹和长期统计都更加准确。学习到的算子具备时间外推能力，且所需步数仅为原来的十分之一。
tldr: 提出通过推导时不变演化算子必须满足的物理一致性方程，将物理知识嵌入一致性学习，实现对混沌系统长期行为的单次跳跃式高效预测，在精度与时间外推能力上优于逐步推进的传统方法。
en_tdlr: This work derives physics-based consistency equations for time-invariant evolution operators, embedding physics into consistency learning to enable efficient single-jump long-horizon prediction of chaotic systems that outperforms step-by-step methods in accuracy and temporal extrapolation.
